productLimits.note: Large fixtures exercise isolated components beyond product limits. These measurements do not certify 512 MiB or 10000-page editing support.

search.note: A missing content query still scans candidate PDFs sequentially; PDFTextStripper keeps per-page text positions.

rendering.note: Bounds generated overview bitmap dimensions and overlapping decodes; does not bound PDF native allocations, displayed bitmap lifetime, or zoom detail on extreme aspect ratios.

library.note: All document metadata is still materialized. Tag lookups reuse a prepared index per document snapshot.

changes: Room version 7 migration adds indices for active/trash sorting and PDF URI lookup.
Metadata projection and tag indexing run off the collecting UI thread; tag filter changes reuse prepared lookups.
Per-operation PDF page indexing avoids repeatedly traversing the page tree.
Text matching uses bounded query/context storage; search publishes progressive batches and limits results to 500.
PDF preview scheduling permits two simultaneous decodes; raster dimensions obey a pixel budget.
Cancellation closes streams and cleans pending imports and partial copies without deleting previously committed documents.

loadScenarios.execution: Targeted Gradle runs with -Pscaniqo.loadTests=true; scenarios and component limits recorded above.

validation.fixtureSafety: Load fixtures are temporary and do not use user documents. Streams and databases close before teardown; scratch cleanup and partial-copy cleanup are asserted. General TemporaryFolder deletion is requested by JUnit but not asserted as successful.
